# Awesome AI Conventions Full Docs Snapshot

> A compact Markdown map of the documentation for LLM retrieval.

## Project Scope

Awesome AI Conventions tracks file-based conventions, predictable public paths, manifests, and open protocols that help humans, codebases, AI agents, and model clients communicate with less ambiguity.

The registry does not list frameworks, SaaS products, private templates, or libraries by themselves. Entries should have public documentation, a canonical repository, a spec, or clear production usage.

## Documentation Map

### Introduction

Use the introduction to understand what belongs in the registry, what does not belong, and where to start.

URL: https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/intro

### README Mirror

The root README remains the source of truth for the curated registry. The Docusaurus mirror makes the same content navigable.

URL: https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/readme

### Layers

The layers page groups conventions by workflow role: instruction, context and state, prompt and capability, evaluation, discoverability, and protocol interoperability.

URL: https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/layers

### Decision Guide

The decision guide helps maintainers choose the smallest useful convention for a project need. It covers repository instructions, persistent context, prompt assets, capabilities, public discoverability, and interoperability.

URL: https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/decision_guide

### Methodology

The methodology page defines inclusion criteria, exclusion criteria, evidence levels, entry shape, update policy, and removal policy.

URL: https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/methodology

### Status Taxonomy

The status taxonomy separates accepted, candidate, watchlist, legacy, and deprecated conventions so readers do not treat every pattern as equally mature.

URL: https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/status_taxonomy

### For Maintainers

The maintainers guide gives a practical path for making repositories easier for agents to understand, starting with `AGENTS.md`, `.aiignore`, and public LLM entry points.

URL: https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/maintainers

## Convention Families

### Project Context Files

Repository-root files that teach coding agents how to work inside a project.

URL: https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/conventions/project-context-files

### Runtime and Guardrails

Files that control what agents should avoid, how work should be staged, and what state is safe to carry across a task.

URL: https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/conventions/runtime-guardrails

### Prompt Assets

Prompt files and prompt formats that keep model instructions versioned with code.

URL: https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/conventions/prompt-assets

### Agent Skills

On-demand capability files and skill registries used by AI agents.

URL: https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/conventions/agent-skills

### Design and UI

Machine-readable design guidance for agents that generate product interfaces.

URL: https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/conventions/design-ui

### Evaluation and Testing

Version-controlled evaluation files for agent behavior and prompt quality.

URL: https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/conventions/evaluation-testing

### Web and LLM Discoverability

Files and well-known URLs that help LLMs discover docs, pricing, and APIs.

URL: https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/conventions/discoverability

### Protocols

Open protocols for connecting agents, tools, resources, and other agents.

URL: https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/conventions/protocols

## Examples

The examples section generates one docs page per file under `examples/**`. Edit source examples in the repository, then run `npm run generate` from `docs/` to refresh generated pages.

URL: https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/examples
